registration_boundary.purpose: Freeze downloaded-source fingerprints, structural census, runtime, and deterministic selector interpretations before loading either neural model for MuSiQue scoring.

frozen_adapter_interpretation.normalization: Collapse Unicode whitespace separately in title and paragraph_text, trim, then join non-empty title and paragraph with one newline.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.deduplication: Deduplicate complete normalized title-plus-paragraph text within each case; union public paragraph indices and supporting labels.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.source_order: Sort deduplicated source documents by normalized-text SHA-256 before assigning neutral source ordinals, so public paragraph order cannot influence deterministic ties.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.candidate_id: case_id + SHA-256-sorted neutral source ordinal + zero-based chunk ordinal; support labels and public paragraph indices are absent.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.chunking: Encode normalized source text without special tokens; emit [start:start+384] at stride 320; decode with skip_special_tokens=true and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=false.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.token_cost: Number of pre-decode content token IDs in the chunk.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.hop_stratum: Length of question_decomposition, joined only during evaluation.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.blind_cache: Prepared and scored caches contain query/candidate text only as ignored runtime inputs; answer, aliases, answerability, decomposition, paragraph idx, is_supporting, and gold units are absent.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.gold_join: All ten methods emit candidate IDs for every budget before the raw source is reopened and support labels are joined.

frozen_scoring_execution.score_semantics: Exactly reuse the v35 per-case BM25, normalized dense, RRF hybrid, calibrated direct cross-encoder, and four mixed role scores.

frozen_selector_execution.dual_resource_ties: larger marginal_F, larger cross-encoder score, lower token_count, ascending candidate_id
frozen_selector_execution.hard_budget_behavior: All methods skip infeasible ranked candidates, return at most five chunks, and never exceed the requested token budget.

stopping_and_output.gate_boundary: The result cannot by itself change Gate 2, authorize CANARY/DEFAULT, reproduce SetR, or establish flood-domain effectiveness.
